{{Quote|We're looking at Cerroban, Aestilan, and Hoth.''"<br />"''That's the bottom of the barrel.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="HAT" />}}
'''Cerroban''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Bon'nyuw-Luq sector/Legends|Bon'nyuw-Luq sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the world was [[Scout/Legends|scouted]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces seeking for a new base. Cerroban was a waterless and airless rocky world that was pounded by [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] regularly.<ref name="HAT" />
